evidence.why: Submenu, acceptance and independent Back branches.
Wrapped navigation, bounds, repeat-delay calls and special guards.

facts.rationale: Corrects the Stock-only endpoint description and preserves the exact input precedence, endpoint guards and exceptional value adjustments.
facts.value: Input is priority ordered with an important distinction: bit 0x200 suppresses the alternative 0x100 acceptance branch even on a non-submenu row, but Back is tested independently afterward. Activating rows 5 or 6 sets entering_menu, installs cooldown 5, opens the submenu, removes the input GObj and commits the cached rules. Navigation wraps through rows 0–6, skipping row 4 in Tournament mode. Value editing wraps within stock-specific or per-row bounds, skips handicap value 1 when mn_804D6BD4 is zero, and excludes the minimum non-stock time value in Tournament mode. On row 1, an actual decrement reaching the minimum or increment reaching the maximum calls gm_801A36E0(4, 0x19); these calls apply to both time and stock editing and do not occur merely because a value wraps.

Entry setup and distinguishing post-construction flag write.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes the VS-menu entry variant from the retained no-argument re-entry initializer and the archive initializer. The VS caller and post-construction flag write establish a useful semantic distinction; historical spelling remains inferred.

evidence.why: Archive-based state reset, resource resolution, process creation and audio setup.

facts.rationale: Describes the full resource-loading entry boundary and distinguishes its archive/variant inputs and scene setup from the two no-argument entry routines, resolving the rendered name collision without claiming recovered historical spelling.

evidence.why: Named resource destinations, variant store and setup consumers.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported Special Melee interpretation of the Ss resource family using its canonical Stage Switch consumer, while preserving archive, variant, process and audio flow.
facts.value: The supplied archive populates shared pointers for the main-menu background, camera, lights, fog, panel, Rules controls, Rules cursor and numeric display, the MenMainCursorTr01–04 and MenMainCursorRl01–05 families, Item Switch resources, and the MenMainConSs/MenMainCursorSs Stage Switch resources. The variant is stored unchanged in mn_804D6BD4 before common menu setup and construction of the Rules presentation through mn_80230E38(1). A separate GObj runs fn_8022F538. The current audio setting returned by gmMainLib_8015ECB0 is forwarded to lbAudioAx_80023F28. Shared subordinate-screen resource pointers remain available to their later constructors rather than being local temporaries.
